visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with an extreme close-up of a large industrial-sized stainless steel pot filled with a thick, savory-looking brown vermicelli noodle soup. A person's hand is visible holding a large metal ladle, vigorously stirring the mixture to ensure even consistency. The lighting is bright and overhead, highlighting the steam and the glistening surface of the thick broth. (2) The shot cuts to a paper bowl being prepared. A pair of metal tongs is used to carefully place pieces of braised large intestines and several plump, grey-colored fresh oysters into the bowl, which is already topped with a sprinkle of bright green cilantro. The bowl has a lucky cat design on its side. (3) A wider shot shows a young male customer in a white t-shirt and black athletic shorts standing in front of a street-side food stall. He is wearing a black crossbody bag. In the background, other customers are seated at simple stainless steel tables on red and green plastic stools under a shop awning with closed metal rolling shutters. (4) Behind the counter, a male cook in a purple sleeveless basketball jersey, a face mask, and a white baseball cap is busy serving food. The stall is cluttered with containers of ingredients, fans, and a large gas tank. A yellow sign above the stall reads '阿鴻麵線' in bold red and blue characters. (5) Back to a close-up of the main pot, where the cook uses a metal ladle to scoop a generous portion of the thin noodles and thick soup into a take-out container. The noodles are fine and submerged in a rich, amber-colored broth. (6) A series of close-up shots show various condiments being added to the bowl. A small spoon adds a splash of clear vinegar, followed by a dollop of white minced garlic, a scoop of dark brown sate sauce, and a drizzle of vibrant red chili oil. Finally, a pinch of fresh green cilantro is added on top. (7) More braised large intestines and oysters are piled onto the seasoned noodles. The camera zooms in to show the texture of the tender intestines and the fresh sheen of the oysters. (8) A pair of white chopsticks lifts a large clump of noodles, pulling an oyster and some intestines along with it. In the background, another bowl of soup and a small dish of red dipping sauce are visible on the stainless steel table. (9) The focus shifts to a second dish. A metal ladle pours clear, steaming soup into a paper bowl containing large cubes of dark maroon pig blood and pieces of pale small intestine. The soup is translucent with visible green chive slices. (10) A close-up of the pig blood soup shows the high density of ingredients, with the dark cubes of blood floating alongside pieces of chitterlings and chopped green chives. (11) A spoon lifts a large, rectangular cube of smooth pig blood and a piece of chewy-looking small intestine to the camera. The textures of the soft blood and the firm intestine are prominent. (12) Another close-up shows a piece of thick, braised large intestine being lifted from the soup, highlighting its fatty and tender appearance. (13) A top-down shot shows the full meal on a stainless steel table: two bowls of soup, a bowl of noodles, and a side dish of sauce. The cook pours more broth into one of the bowls. (14) The final sequence shows the empty seating area of the shop with red and green stools, followed by a wide shot of the '阿鴻麵線' stall at a street corner. Large white text overlays provide the specific address in Kaohsiung.
